instruction.name: pcalau12i
instruction.description: Compute PC plus a sign-extended 20-bit immediate shifted left by 12, with the low 12 bits cleared.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: pcalau12i $r12, 1; pcalau12i $r13, 1; pcalau12i $r14, 1; pcalau12i $r15, 1; pcalau12i $r16, 1; pcalau12i $r17, 1; pcalau12i $r18, 1; pcalau12i $r19, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --asm 'pcalau12i $r12, 1; pcalau12i $r13, 1; pcalau12i $r14, 1; pcalau12i $r15, 1; pcalau12i $r16, 1; pcalau12i $r17, 1; pcalau12i $r18, 1; pcalau12i $r19, 1'
throughput.notes: pcalau12i has no GPR source; latency is not defined. 8 operations take 3.33 cycles.
